project.name: MAX Grounding
project.purpose: Provide a self-hostable evidence-first grounding engine that retrieves, validates, compresses, and cites external evidence for LLMs and agents without giving the model authority to invent facts.
expected_outcomes: grounded responses backed by explicit evidence and citations
cross-platform core runtime with containerized service integrations

external_systems: Docker/OCI linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 production image

entry_points.name: Python package
entry_points.purpose: bootstrap runtime identity and package boundary

entry_points.name: SearXNG provider
entry_points.purpose: bounded live HTTP search against a trusted self-hosted SearXNG endpoint

entry_points.name: Lexical retrieval
entry_points.purpose: deterministic bounded chunking and in-memory BM25 lexical retrieval over fetched text

entry_points.name: Semantic retrieval
entry_points.purpose: bounded provider-agnostic dense semantic retrieval with role-separated embedding contracts

entry_points.name: Hybrid fusion
entry_points.purpose: fixed equal-weight reciprocal-rank fusion of bounded lexical and semantic results

entry_points.name: Reranking and context compression
entry_points.purpose: bounded provider-agnostic reranking plus deterministic extractive evidence compression

entry_points.name: Temporal authority scoring
entry_points.purpose: validate explicit temporal/source metadata, obtain injected authority scores, and rank bounded evidence by deterministic freshness and point-in-time validity

entry_points.name: Evidence graph
entry_points.purpose: build bounded structured corroboration/contradiction relations and distinct-source evidence clusters without selecting truth

entry_points.name: Claim verification
entry_points.purpose: verify exact structured answer claims against the evidence graph, bind claim-level citations, compute a deterministic evidence-sufficiency index, and expose only supported claims for synthesis

entry_points.name: Ollama embedding adapter
entry_points.purpose: pinned stdlib HTTP adapter for Ollama 0.34.0 and qwen3-embedding:0.6b with validated 1024-dimensional query/document embeddings

entry_points.name: Qdrant vector store
entry_points.purpose: pinned stdlib REST adapter for Qdrant 1.19.1 collection validation, provenance-bound upsert, and bounded vector query

entry_points.name: Persistent semantic retrieval
entry_points.purpose: orchestrate deterministic chunking, concrete embedding, persistent indexing, and validated Qdrant semantic retrieval

entry_points.name: Production service facade
entry_points.purpose: compose accepted search, secure fetch, Ollama embedding, and Qdrant persistence behind bounded production operations

entry_points.name: Production REST application
entry_points.purpose: serve authenticated bounded REST operations plus public liveness and authenticated readiness

entry_points.name: Production MCP server
entry_points.purpose: expose four structured retrieval tools and one deterministic verified-output tool over authenticated Streamable HTTP

entry_points.name: Production container
entry_points.purpose: run the production ASGI service as a non-root container on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64

constraints: GitHub Actions is the acceptance authority.
Every completed phase is merged to main only after all required checks pass.
Core runtime must remain portable across Linux, Windows, and macOS.
Untrusted network content must never be treated as executable instructions.
No secrets may be committed to the repository.
